options.text: Hydrogen that has been dyed green for safety
Hydrogen produced by electrolysis of water using renewable electricity
Hydrogen produced by burning natural gas

questions.explanation: Green hydrogen is hydrogen produced by the electrolysis of water using electricity from renewable sources such as wind or solar power. This is truly clean because no fossil fuels are involved. Most hydrogen today is produced by steam reforming of natural gas, which is not green because it uses fossil fuels and produces CO2.
